recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the FHIR-29260 narrative alignment without changing the conformance model, and future subject-target changes should update the element definition, mapping exceptions, and Observation notes together to avoid repeating this drift.
issue_request: FHIR-29260 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification OO resolution for R5. It requested adding Organization, Procedure, and Practitioner to Observation.subject, clarifying how Procedure is used as a subject in the regulatory inspection process, and keeping those additions STU rather than immediately normative.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to git f88c6800c3, which updated the then-authoritative Observation spreadsheet by adding Organization, Procedure, and Practitioner to Observation.subject and adding the procedure/regulatory-inspection clarification. Current source has since moved to StructureDefinition XML, and source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml preserves those targetProfiles and the Procedure clarification.
additional_context: Later subject-expansion work added Medication, Substance, BiologicallyDerivedProduct, and NutritionProduct to Observation.subject; FHIR-29031 already reconciled the element definition and mapping text for those later targets. FHIR-29930 and FHIR-32575 are already represented on the combined branch and explain the related DiagnosticReport subject/focus path, including that the DiagnosticReport Procedure cleanup does not reverse Procedure as an Observation.subject. FHIR-40335 later added subject/focus/device guidance to Observation notes, but the lead-in sentence still listed only the pre-FHIR-29260 subject examples.
reconciliation: Updated source/observation/observation-notes.xml in the active Observation resource folder so the built 'Subject of an Observation' narrative lists the current Observation.subject target set instead of the old Patient/Group/Location/Device-only wording. Generated-looking diagram text in source/observation/observation.svg was not edited.
